plain_english_summary: Doctor login was silently failing because the app's OTP calls were still pointed at an old, dead server address. This fix repoints those calls at the correct, currently-running server.
correct_agent_response: Code complete. auth.ts now imports the shared API base URL instead of a hardcoded (and dead) server address — all four login-related functions (send code, verify code, verify patient code, refresh session) are affected. Small, single-purpose, two-file change.
